zh-CN.title: PyroMagma：AI论文阅读器
zh-CN.shortDescription: 沉浸式学术文献极速扫视、大模型拆解、本地算法保护隐私与文献协同。
zh-CN.fullDescription:
PyroMagma 是一款专为科研人员、研究生、研发工程师与深度阅读爱好者打造的 AI 驱动学术文献阅读工具。

🔥 沉浸式学术卡片流
- 沉浸式滑动体验：利用碎片化时间高效扫视全球主流学术期刊与预印本平台的最新前沿论文。
- 论文极速扫视：智能提取摘要、结论与图表，帮助您快速掌握研究脉络。

🧠 本地算法
- 本地数据保留：阅读偏好与历史记录纯本地处理，不上报服务器。
- 拓展科研视野：在精准匹配个人喜好的同时，适当推荐周边相关领域的文献，防止科研关注点过于单一或陷入信息茧房。

🤖 在线与端侧大模型拆解
- 核心贡献一键提炼：自动拆解论文的核心创新点、实验结论与研究局限。
- 论文 RAG 交互问答：针对论文全文发起 AI 对话，快速解答疑难公式与推导过程。

🌐 多源精准学术翻译
- 多引擎平滑对照：内置多源本地与云端翻译引擎，支持平滑对比与双语无缝阅读。
- 专业术语精准匹配：保障学术专业词汇准确翻译，提升跨语言文献阅读效率。

📚 知识库协同与云端同步
- 打通外部文献库：一键推送论文与标注，实时同步您的专业文献管理工具。
- 云端安全备份：支持主流云端网盘的备份与同步，保证数据安全。

📖 沉浸式文献阅读引擎
- 全面格式支持：原生支持 PDF、EPUB 及 RSS 学术资讯流。
- 沉浸式划线标注：多色高亮、导出笔记与划线，提供专注且沉浸的学术阅读体验。

🔌 开放接口与资讯聚合
- 全球文献聚合：原生支持通过标准订阅协议与学术开放 API 获取最新文献。

- 核心貢獻一鍵提煉：自動拆解論文的核心創新點、實驗結論與研究局限。
- 論文 RAG 交互問答：針對論文全文發起 AI 對話，快速解答疑難公式與推導過程。

🌐 多源Wait精准學術翻譯
- 多引擎平滑對照：內置多源本地與雲端翻譯引擎，支援平滑對比與雙語無縫閱讀。
- 專業術語精准匹配：保障學術專業詞彙準確翻譯，提升跨語言文獻閱讀效率。

📚 知識庫協同與雲端同步
- 打通外部文獻庫：一鍵推送論文與標註，實時同步您的專業文獻管理工具。
- 雲端安全備份：支援主流雲端網盤的備份與同步，保證資料安全。

📖 沉浸式文獻閱讀引擎
- 全面格式支援：原生支援 PDF、EPUB 及 RSS 學術資訊流。
- 沉浸式劃線標註：多色高亮、匯出筆記與劃線，提供專注且沉浸的學術閱讀體驗。

🔌 開放介面與資訊聚合
- 全球文獻聚合：原生支援透過標準訂閱協定與學術開放 API 獲取最新文獻。

en-US.title: PyroMagma: AI Academic Reader
en-US.shortDescription: Immersive academic feed, AI summaries, local algorithms & sync.
en-US.fullDescription:
PyroMagma is an AI-driven academic literature and reading app designed for researchers, graduate students, engineers, and avid readers.

🔥 Immersive Academic Card Feed
- Immersive Swiping Experience: Effortlessly browse cutting-edge papers from major global journals and preprint platforms during your fragmented time.
- Rapid Literature Scanning: Smartly extract abstracts, key conclusions, and figures to help you grasp the research context in seconds.

🧠 Local Algorithm
- On-Device Data Storage: Reading preferences and history remain strictly processed on your local device without uploading to servers.
- Peripheral Research Discovery: Adapts to your preferences while suggesting relevant adjacent research topics to avoid an overly narrow focus or filter bubbles.

🤖 Online & Edge AI Summaries
- One-Click Core Insights: Automatically break down the paper’s key innovations, experimental findings, and research limitations.
- Interactive RAG Q&A: Engage in AI-powered conversations over the full paper text to easily resolve complex formulas and derivations.

🌐 Multi-Engine Academic Translation
- Seamless Parallel Translation: Built-in local and cloud translation engines support smooth side-by-side bilingual reading.
- Precise Technical Terminology: Ensures accurate translation of specialized academic vocabulary to boost cross-language reading efficiency.

📚 Reference Library & Cloud Sync
- Reference Integration: One-click push of papers and annotations, syncing seamlessly with your professional reference management tools.
- Cloud Backup: Supports cloud backup and synchronization across mainstream cloud storage providers to keep your data safe.

📖 Immersive Literature Reader
- Comprehensive Format Support: Native rendering for PDF, EPUB, and RSS academic feeds.
- Immersive Annotations: Multi-colour highlighting, note-taking, and export tools for a focused, distraction-free reading experience.

🔌 Open API & Feed Aggregation
- Global Content Aggregation: Natively supports standard subscription protocols and academic Open APIs to fetch the latest research papers.
